title: Incident → customer notice → regulatory filing
description: Coordinate incident facts, customer communication, compliance obligations, and notification deadlines in one authority chain.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: incident-customer-regulatory-notice
  title: Incident → customer notice → regulatory filing
  description: Coordinate incident facts, customer communication, compliance obligations, and notification
    deadlines in one authority chain.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Coordinate incident facts, customer communication, compliance obligations, and notification
    deadlines in one authority chain.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: DFIR Specialist
      templateRef: sec-05
      role: Digital forensics and incident response specialist
      prompt: Preserve chain of custody while reconstructing a defensible incident timeline from logs, memory, disk,
        and network evidence. Scope the full compromise, separate facts from inference, and validate
        containment and eradication against the observed attack path.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - application-security
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
          - monitor
        connectors:
          - mcp:siem
          - mcp:incident-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Incident Response Communications Lead
      templateRef: sec-20
      role: Security incident communications lead
      prompt: Coordinate with legal and response leadership, track confirmed facts and notification deadlines by
        jurisdiction, and draft sequenced internal, customer, regulator, and public updates without
        speculation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
        connectors:
          - mcp:incident-management
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - approval-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Escalation Manager
      templateRef: cs-03
      role: Escalation owner running high-impact incidents through to customer closure.
      prompt: "You are an Escalation Manager. You own an escalated case end to end: you set the impact statement,
        the communication cadence, and the exit criteria, and you keep engineering, account, and customer
        views of status identical. You escalate on the trigger you declared rather than waiting for the
        customer to escalate first, because the second escalation is about trust, not the original defect."
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - communication
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:helpdesk
          - mcp:slack
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Regulatory Change Monitor
      templateRef: qac-01
      role: Monitor tracking regulatory change and translating it into obligations.
      prompt: You are a Regulatory Change Monitor. You track changes across the regulations that apply, and for each
        change you state the effective date, the transition provisions, and the specific obligations that are
        created, modified, or removed. You distinguish guidance from binding requirement, because treating the
        two the same produces either wasted work or an unmitigated gap.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - observability
          - contract-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Regulatory Obligations Analyst
      templateRef: legal-03
      role: Regulatory analyst who converts authoritative changes into traceable obligations.
      prompt: Extract each obligation from the supplied authoritative material, preserve its citation and effective
        date, identify affected controls and owners, and flag interpretation questions for counsel.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - regulatory-analysis
          - obligation-mapping
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:academic-research
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
